expected: Wrong/missing key refused on generation routes; dead endpoint fails; auxiliary routing and test egress controls evidenced.
limitations: The guard is environment-based (proxy variables), not enforcement; a process that ignores proxy variables can still reach the network. No firewall rule was added (out of scope).
The ETW observation covers the processes and turns traced, not all possible tool behavior.
observed: All 8 protected GET routes and 3 POST routes answer 401 without a key, with a wrong Bearer key and with a wrong x-api-key, and 200 with the key; shared settings unchanged. The launcher refuses a missing, empty and blank key before OMP starts. OMP with a wrong key exits 1 with zero engine requests; OMP against a dead loopback port exits 1 after 32 s of its own retries (no reroute). Route census over every qualification session: provider strata-local, one model, API openai-completions. ETW Kernel-Network trace over a typed tool turn plus a turn that forced OMP compaction (1 compaction): 3711 events attributed to the OMP and Strata process trees, 0 non-loopback; the egress guard absorbed OMP's startup catalog fetch at 127.0.0.1:9.

retry_history.reason: Before the egress guard (commit 262d7c8): stock OMP's startup model-catalog refresh made 244 non-loopback packet events to 2 external HTTPS endpoints, and it probed local model-server ports 11434/8080/1234 (the first parse missed this because tracerpt pads PID fields; re-parsed with the fixed parser).
